references.text: God sends Moses to deliver Israel from Egypt, just as he sends Gideon to deliver Israel from the Midianites. Both receive a divine call and mission.
God sends Joshua to lead Israel into the promised land, with the promise of his presence and strength, just as he sends Gideon with power to save Israel.
Deborah conveys God's call to Barak to go and deliver Israel from Sisera, similar to God's call to Gideon to deliver Israel from the Midianites.
The Lord sent judges, including Gideon (Jerubbaal), to deliver Israel from their enemies, confirming God's pattern of sending chosen leaders.
Isaiah is sent by God with a mission, just as Gideon was sent to carry out God's will.
Jeremiah is sent by God to fulfill his mission, like Gideon's call. God assures both of his support.
Gideon is mentioned among the heroes of faith who overcame enemies and carried out justice through faith, confirming his role in God's story of salvation.
